docsfresh.text: <N> dated markers in docs are older than 30 days: resolve or re-date each with a source. ACCEPT: docs_fresh.py stale prints 0. ZERO-CLICK: the loop works it. SOURCE: watch refresh docs, filed <YYYY-MM-DD>.

shots.text: The screenshot manifest is stale since <SINCE>: run tools/shots.py render and commit docs/shots. ACCEPT: shots.py check exits 0; no window appeared. ZERO-CLICK: the loop works it. SOURCE: watch refresh shots, filed <YYYY-MM-DD>.

reldue.text: <N> rows merged in <D> days since the last tag with no release row open: decide whether they make a milestone and, if so, file a REL-PREP row that waits on them. ACCEPT: a REL-PREP row exists or a dated "no milestone" line. SOURCE: watch refresh notes, filed <YYYY-MM-DD>.
